=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:201-209 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A ledger-only commit suppresses the sandbox-excluded escalation marker. `review_commit_changes.sh:677` writes `DID_COMMIT=true` after any commit, including the ledger-only commit at lines 717-722. COMMITTED_FILES_FILE then holds `- .ai/review_issue_ledger/pr-N.txt`, so the text check at 201-204 sets `sandbox_excluded_nothing_committed=0`, and the DID_COMMIT override at 205-209 does not exclude `LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT=true`.
  WHY: For a consumer whose `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH` points at a tracked path, a `not-edited` run that declines a fix as `sandbox-excluded path` writes no `review-autofix-failure:v1` marker and the head is never capped, which recreates the PR #8250 loop that #8321 exists to stop. Severity disagreement: gemini=BLOCKER (mapped to critical), minimax=MAJOR, glm=NIT; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this finding, giving three reasons: the text check at line 202 already blocks the marker; LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT is also set at review_commit_changes.sh line 777 on audit-convergence commits that carry real edits, so only LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT_STRICT would separate the cases; and the pushed commit moves the head, so the marker would not cap anyway. It also notes the default ledger path is gitignored.
- tests/test_review_editor_sandbox_excluded_escalation.py:180-186 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The only `DID_COMMIT=true` test case (`test_did_commit_true_writes_no_marker_even_with_placeholder_text`) covers a scenario that cannot occur in production (`- none\n` committed-files plus `DID_COMMIT=true`). No test row covers the real ledger-only commit (`DID_COMMIT=true`, `LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT=true`, ledger path in COMMITTED_FILES_FILE).
  WHY: The test suite cannot catch a regression that suppresses the marker for tracked-ledger consumers. Source severity is MAJOR (mapped to high).

The agents.d fragment `agents.d/8321-review-editor-claude-docs.md` lists the DID_COMMIT condition without a LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT exclusion. No test row covers the ledger-only path. Severity disagreement: gemini=BLOCKER, minimax=MAJOR, luna=NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 reported no task gaps and found every #8321 deliverable present.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- NOTE: This reviewer rejected the pass-1 z-ai_glm-5_3-flash finding ("a ledger-only commit suppresses the escalation marker") for three reasons:
  (1) The text check at line 202 fails first, so changing the DID_COMMIT check alone would not write a marker.
  (2) LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT is also set at review_commit_changes.sh line 777 on audit-convergence commits that carry real source edits, so exempting it would bring back false positives. Only LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT_STRICT would be a correct discriminator.
  (3) A ledger-only commit is pushed, which moves the head, so the marker would not cap the next dispatch. This case also arises only for a tracked REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH; the default path is gitignored (lines 684-687).
- It also found every deliverable from issue #8321 present, and review_autofix.yml not edited.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE (it calls the pass-1 LEDGER_ONLY_COMMIT exemption unsafe as written). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 0.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:202-205 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new `DID_COMMIT=true` check handles ledger-only commits incorrectly, because they also set `DID_COMMIT=true`. When only the ledger is committed, `sandbox_excluded_nothing_committed` is set to 0 and the escalation marker is not written.
  WHY: A consumer repo whose editor keeps declining a `.claude/` fix as "sandbox-excluded path" is not capped if it records the run in the review ledger, which leads to endless re-runs of an issue that cannot be fixed.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: When a run declines a fix only because its path is outside the sandbox, write the escalation marker and stop the head.
  Expected change site: scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh (sandbox detection logic)
  Evidence of absence: `sandbox_excluded_nothing_committed` is set to 0 when `DID_COMMIT=true`, which is also true for ledger-only commits. The marker should be written whenever the only reason for the decline is the sandbox path and no *functional* changes were committed.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
